title: Geri Dönüşüm Ülkesi
author: Meryem Ermeydan
description: Once upon a time, a sunflower oil named Aykız lived in the Land of Recycling. Left alone on the street as waste oil, she was unwelcome even in nature. Just when everything reached an impasse, a wise old man named Aksakallı Dede arrived, and Aykız’s journey to recycling began. The Land of Recycling entered the White Ravens Catalogue in 2021.
